metadata.title: Secure Email Campaign Platform SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining trust boundaries, consent guarantees, enforcement invariants, and accountability for the institutional Email Campaign Platform.

import-profile.remarks: Imports the institutional security, privacy, records, and regulatory control baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional platform for authorized, high-volume outbound email campaigns to students, staff, faculty, and public stakeholders, with mandatory consent enforcement, opt-out guarantees, and auditability.

information-type.title: Email Address
information-type.description: Individual electronic mail address used for campaign delivery.

information-type.title: Consent Status
information-type.description: Certified indication of whether electronic communication is permitted under applicable law.

information-type.title: Opt-Out and Suppression State
information-type.description: Authoritative opt-out records including single-scope, multi-scope, and global suppression.

information-type.title: Campaign and Delivery History
information-type.description: Records of campaigns, recipients, delivery outcomes, engagement telemetry, and enforcement decisions.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Email Campaign Platform is a consumption SSPP layered on the Secure Email Platform SSPP.

props.name: primary-pattern
props.remarks: This platform implements the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway pattern.

props.name: usage-constraint
props.remarks: The platform MUST NOT be used for ad-hoc, emergency, transactional, notification, or personal messaging.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Campaigns may target students, staff, faculty, and approved public stakeholders only.

props.name: recipient-constraint
props.remarks: Recipients MUST be individual email addresses. Distribution lists, shared mailboxes, role accounts, and application mailboxes are prohibited.

props.name: content-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Campaign content MUST be restricted to publicly distributable (Level 1) information.

props.name: consent-authority
props.remarks: Consent eligibility originates from authoritative external systems under formal data sharing agreements.

props.name: opt-out-enforcement
props.remarks: The Email Campaign Platform is the authoritative enforcement point for opt-out and suppression decisions.

props.name: opt-out-non-overridable
props.remarks: Opt-out decisions MUST NOT be overridden by campaign logic, targeting rules, or sender preference.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for trustworthy email guidance related to policy enforcement, consent handling, monitoring, and accountability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for secure handling of high-volume outbound email and abuse prevention.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced to emphasize abuse-at-scale, reputational impact, and recovery as cyber resiliency concerns.

props.name: branding-constraint
props.remarks: Sender identities and templates require institutional branding approval prior to use.

props.name: tenant-isolation
props.remarks: Campaign data, recipient information, audit logs, and sender identities are logically isolated per account.

props.name: audit-evidence-availability
props.remarks: Campaign, opt-out, and delivery records are retained per authoritative records and retention requirements.

system-implementation.remarks: The Email Campaign Platform enforces trust through invariant guarantees (authorization, consent, suppression, auditability) rather than procedural controls.

components.title: Email Campaign Platform
components.description: Consumes certified consent state, enforces opt-out decisions, filters recipients at send time, and produces auditable campaign and delivery records.

links.text: Consumes certified consent and communication eligibility data.
Publishes opt-out and suppression state to prevent re-enrollment.
Forwards enforcement and campaign execution events for centralized audit correlation.

roles.title: Campaign Platform Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for governance, lifecycle, access attestation, cost responsibility, and compliance.

roles.title: Campaign Author
roles.remarks: Authors campaign content and proposes recipient targeting.

roles.title: Campaign Approver
roles.remarks: Approves campaign intent and compliance with institutional and regulatory requirements.

roles.title: Email Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates platform infrastructure, enforcement, and integration points.

control-implementation.remarks: All security and privacy controls are inherited from the Secure Email Platform SSPP and its underlying patterns; no controls are implemented directly by this SSPP.
